name: publish-to-wiki
title_zh: 研究稿写完全文，一键落进自家 Wiki 待审区
tagline_zh: 长文写完别躺聊天记录里。它把 markdown 归到 wiki/research/，wiki.home 立即可读。
tagline_en: Long-form done, don't let it rot in chat. Files land in wiki/research/, live at wiki.home, and it proactively.
desc_en: Publish a markdown research or analysis file to the home Wiki.js (homelab/wiki-content) under research/, where it renders at wiki.home for review. Use when a research report, analysis, or long-form markdown file has been written on the homelab and should go to the wiki. Also follow the proactive-offer behavior below after writing any such file.
why_zh: 它把「写完」和「发布」之间的空档补上了：不是手动拖文件，而是写完即触发询问，按既定目录归档。
why_en: Bridges the gap between 'written' and 'published': triggers on completion, asks before filing, and routes into a fixed research/.
limit_zh: 只认 homelab 里 Wiki.js 的 wiki-content 仓库。
limit_en: Only for Wiki.js in this homelab's wiki-content repo, markdown research/analysis only. No image handling, no index building, no auto-merge to.
title_en: Ship finished research to your home Wiki for review
